messages:
maya: heads up — started migrating the JS SDK to ESM-only and hit runtime issues on Cloudflare Workers
kevin: what errors? runtime stack?
maya: auth headers stripped during DO fetches, and our retry flow relies on node-fetch AbortController semantics
lina: Workers have fetch + AbortController but no Node builtins. Are we bundling node polyfills by accident?
maya: yes — bundle pulled in isomorphic-fetch which expects process. CF throws "ReferenceError: process is not defined"
dario: classic bundler miss. rollup config needs node builtins externalized for edge targets
kevin: retries use setTimeout backoff. Workers expose globalThis.setTimeout but some TS configs don't include webworker lib leading to type errors
maya: repro from a user: "Property 'setTimeout' does not exist on type 'WorkerGlobalScope'" — they had libs only es2020
lina: docs fix: example tsconfig: { "lib": ["es2021","webworker","dom"] }
dario: header strip detail: CF will drop some headers if you clone Request and mutate headers; avoid node-style clones and forward init properly
maya: also our fetch wrapper did response.clone().json() twice which breaks stream consumption on Workers. change to single await response.json()
kevin: typing idea: publish "@redwood/inference/worker" entrypoint that re-exports the client but built with no node deps and a d.ts that references webworker
lina: set package.json "browser" field + ESM entry that imports nothing Node-specific
maya: short-term build hack: alias isomorphic-fetch -> global-fetch-polyfill that exports globalThis.fetch and AbortController if present
dario: add CI step: wrangler/miniflare smoke test running auth+retry scenarios
kevin: opened PR #1123 with alias + tsconfig docs. Requested a follow-up worker entrypoint PR
lina: I'll draft the quickstart snippet and tsconfig note: `import { Redwood } from '@redwood/inference/worker'`
maya: infra-bot: wrangler + miniflare smoke test queued (job 8791)
infra-bot: job 8791 started
maya: miniflare smoke passed but failed on real CF due to header strip. reducing repro now
kevin: add "Known gotchas: Cloudflare Workers" in SDK docs listing node APIs, tsconfig, and packager externals
dario: action items: (1) worker entrypoint + d.ts (kevin) (2) docs + quickstart (lina) (3) CI smoke with miniflare/wrangler (maya)
maya: filing triage card and linking PR #1123
kevin: :thumbsup: this explains several support tickets that looked like auth failures
maya: follow-up — adding build matrix jobs: --format=es --target=webworker to catch regressions
